written: 2026-11-12, before any LLM call; not changed since
use: Evaluation: each instruction is read once at seeds 26300 and 26301 (standard setting, 4 m; 80 units clustered by layout). The 12 marked physics are also run as simulated errands (one per layout). All are reported, none selected.
semantics: intent in household roles of the layout (configs/household_roles.json): fetch = what to bring; priority = the objects that matter most (weight PRIORITY_WEIGHT = 3, every other fetched object 1); before = [x, y]: x gone before any trip holding y (so never in one trip); never_pair = [a, b] never carried together

instructions.text: Could you bring me the biscuits and the tea, please?
Bring me the biscuits, the juice and the tea. The biscuits are the important thing, don't lose them.
I need the juice and the biscuits, and the tea box too. Bring the juice first. Above all, make sure the biscuits arrive.
Fetch the medicine bottle first, then the rice box and the toothbrush pack.
Bring the medicine and the rice, but never carry the medicine together with the rice box.
Bring me the medicine bottle, the toothbrush pack and the rice. The medicine matters most, and don't carry it with the rice box.
Just the tissues and the tea box, please.
Bring the tea box, the tissues and the tape reel.
Bring the tissues, the tea and the vase. The vase must not break, so it matters most. Bring the tissues first.
Bring me the sweets, the soup and the tea. The sweets matter most.
Bring the sweets and the toothbrush pack, but keep them apart: don't carry them together.
I'd like the soup box, the tea box and the sweets. The tea box comes first. The sweets are what matters most.
Bring me everything except the toaster and the candle.
First the soup box, then the cereal bars.
Bring the cereal bars, the tissues and the soup box. Don't carry the cereal bars together with the soup. The cereal bars matter most.
Fetch me the things to take medicine for my kid: the medicine bottle and the pill box first, and then the juice to wash it down. The medicine matters most.
Bring the medicine bottle and the juice can, but don't carry them together.
Please bring the pill box, the soup box and the juice. Don't lose the pill box, it's the important one.
Bring me the medicine and the pills, nothing else.
Bring the candle first, then the tea box and the rice box.
Bring the rice box, the tea box and the toothbrush pack. Take most care of the rice box.
Bring me the toothbrush pack, the tea box and the candle. The candle matters most. Bring the toothbrush pack before the tea box.
Bring the cereal bars, the medicine bottle and the soup box, but never carry the medicine with the cereal bars.
Bring the medicine bottle first, and then the tea box.
I need the medicine, the toothbrush pack and the cereal bars. The medicine is the most important. Don't carry the medicine with the toothbrush pack.
Bring me the chocolates, the biscuits and the tea.
Bring the chocolates, the biscuits, the tea box and the soup box. The chocolates matter most.
Bring the biscuits, the chocolates and the soup, but don't carry the chocolates together with the biscuits.
Bring all the food: the chocolates, the biscuits, the tea and the soup. Bring the soup first. The biscuits matter most.
Bring the rice box first, then the pill box and the toothbrush pack.
Bring the rice box, the toothbrush pack and the pill box. The pill box is the one that matters most.
Bring the pill box, the rice box and the tape reel. The rice box matters most. Don't carry the rice box with the tape reel.
Bring me the tissues, the toothbrush pack and the pill box.
Bring the biscuits and the pill box, but don't carry them together.
Bring the biscuits, then the tissues.
Bring the biscuits, the pill box and the toothbrush pack. The pill box first. The biscuits matter most.
Bring the juice can, the tissues and the pill box. Make sure the juice can arrives; it matters most.
Bring the pill box first, and then the juice and the toothbrush pack.
Bring the candle, the tissues and the juice can, but never carry the juice together with the tissues.
Bring me the juice, the toothbrush pack and the tissues. The juice matters most, and bring the tissues before the toothbrush pack.
